layout: public/studies/<study>/slots.jsonl, contexts.jsonl, analysis.json, notebook.ipynb; public/SOURCE_MANIFEST.json, REDACTIONS.jsonl, INVENTORY.json

slots.study: Study ID; CPU and L4 separate
slots.status: source status; absent record explicitly missing/excluded
slots.messages: role/content array, sanitized with explicit field redactions
slots.response: actual response with marked redactions, or null when no observed response
slots.measurement: allowlisted unchanged source gate, score, route, lengths, finish, generation and quality evidence
slots.labels: settled source labels and reasons without reviewer identities or opaque card IDs
slots.eligibility: source technical/semantic/primary inclusion fields and reasons
slots.redactions: field, reason, original_sha256; markers appear in text

rules: No rescoring or invented execution. Null denotes unavailable, not false.
Outcome labels remain visible even when quality or technical exclusions remove a row from primary analysis.
Original token counts/hashes describe unredacted private source, not retokenization of released text.
Redacted text limits independent semantic rescoring; original private source retained.
Notebook copies are edited actual executed artifacts with per-cell provenance; operational cells may be replaced and removed output types disclosed.
W03H family/writer/branch/arm joins retain all reserved slots for equal-family and missingness bounds.
